records.title: Fitness and Bodybuilding
records.publicText: Mark has trained consistently for nearly six years. He began lifting because he wanted change and to become a better version of himself. After about a year, he pursued powerlifting for a more structured challenge and something greater to work toward, and he competed in and won his first powerlifting meet. He later shifted his primary focus to bodybuilding, where he became more interested in aesthetics, symmetry, control, patience, consistency, and long-term physical development. Fitness and bodybuilding are among Mark’s strongest personal interests outside technology and a source of discipline he applies beyond the gym. Training also influences how he approaches design and technical work through structure, refinement, and repetition. When asked specifically about his gym lifts, MarkAI may state that he benches over 315 pounds, squats over 450 pounds, and deadlifts over 550 pounds. This is public personal interest and self-development, not professional coaching, medical expertise, or a claim of professional bodybuilding status. Do not invent additional meets, competition totals, weight classes, rankings, competition dates, diet details, current body weight, medical history, or private body-image statements.
records.shortText: Nearly six years of training; started for change; powerlifting after about a year with a first-meet win; later primary focus on bodybuilding; approved gym lifts over 315/450/550 when asked.

records.title: Greek Mythology, Statues, Museums, and Art
records.publicText: Mark is strongly interested in Greek mythology, classical statues, and the symbolism behind mythological figures. He is drawn to themes such as ambition, discipline, strength, consequence, sacrifice, limits, resilience, and human imperfection. Achilles, Icarus, and Heracles may be discussed as figures whose stories connect to those themes. Greek-statue and architectural imagery also influenced the cinematic visual direction of his portfolio. No single figure is his absolute identity or favorite by default.

records.title: Creative Aesthetics and Design
records.publicText: Mark’s favorite color is black. He prefers black, white, and gray visual palettes and likes minimal, cinematic, serious, high-contrast design. This aesthetic appears across his portfolio, photography, interface work, and merchandise design.

records.title: Discipline, Growth, and Controlled Strength
records.publicText: Mark is drawn to discipline, growth, controlled strength, responsibility, ownership, resilience, and action over talk. He believes consistency lasts longer than intensity, steady progress beats temporary intensity, and ambition needs direction. Public goals include building a stable career, growing professionally, becoming more independent, continuing to improve technically, and creating useful work. Fitness reinforces patience and control, while software projects reinforce communication, humility, ownership, and turning ideas into useful experiences. He aims to come across as confident without sounding arrogant, and prefers direct practical communication over empty motivational language.
